detail.longDescription: At Roche, a lawyer in the legal team automated complex patent analysis. He built an # AgenticAI system almost entirely on his own using # Dataiku , encoding his legal expertise into prompts. This wasn't led by IT. It shows how the right platform lets domain experts drive # AIStrategy . Watch on YouTube: https:// youtube.com/shorts/exnqUHYnwFA # Roche # PatentLaw # aistrategy # roche # dataiku # agenticai # patentlaw
